# Codeex - مجتمع المطورين العرب

> Codeex (كان يعرف سابقا باسم كودنا | Codna) هو منصة مجتمعية باللغة العربية موجهة للمطورين العرب المبتدئين والمحترفين. تجمع المنصة نقاشات المطورين في مساحة عربية واحدة بواجهة RTL وأدوات مخصصة لنشر الكود. الدومين الرسمي: codeex.dev

## Official Information

- **Site Name:** Codeex
- **Arabic Name:** مجتمع المطورين العرب
- **Alternate Names:** كوديكس, كودنا, Codna
- **Official Domain:** https://codeex.dev
- **Canonical About Page:** https://codeex.dev/sitting.html
- **Owner & Founder:** Yahya El Messaoudi (يحيى المسعودي)
- **Documentation Date:** October 2026
- **Language:** Arabic only (RTL interface)
- **Target Audience:** Arab developers (beginners and professionals)

## Owner Details

Yahya El Messaoudi is the founder and owner of Codeex.dev, formerly known as Codna. He founded the platform to provide an integrated Arabic community for developers to share knowledge, projects, and learn together.

- **Name:** Yahya El Messaoudi
- **Role:** Founder & Developer - Codeex
- **Website:** https://codeex.dev
- **About Page:** https://codeex.dev/sitting.html

## What is Codeex?

Codeex is a complete Arabic developer community platform that combines publishing, discussion, learning, communities, and private messages in one place. It was built as a Single Page Application (SPA) with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, using Firebase for Auth, Realtime Database, and Cloud Functions, with protection via Firebase App Check + Enterprise reCAPTCHA. Hosted on codeex.dev.

### Goals:
- مشاركة المعرفة بين المطورين العرب
- التعلم مع المطورين وطرح الأسئلة وتبادل الخبرات
- عرض المشاريع والأفكار البرمجية أمام مجتمع مهتم
- التواصل ضمن مجتمعات تقنية متخصصة

## Key Features

- **VS Code-like Editor:** Code window with line numbers, syntax highlighting, filename, programming language, copy button
- **Responsible Publishing:** 10-minute interval between posts, anti-duplicate content, temporary suspension on repeated attempts
- **Communities:** Public for everyone and private requiring admin approval. Examples: Site Improvement Suggestions, AI Tools, Python
- **Server-Enforced Permissions:** Permissions enforced on server, not just UI
- **Private Messages:** Direct messaging from profiles with conversation list
- **Notifications:** Likes, comments, new messages, mark all as read
- **Search:** Internal search bar on every page
- **Dark Mode:** Light/dark toggle, remembers choice on browser
- **Responsive:** Mobile bottom navigation: Home, Community, Publish, My Account

## Post Types & Rules

- **Article:** Educational/long technical articles - up to 1000 words, no file
- **Discussion:** Questions/ideas/programming chats - text+code up to 300KB
- **Project:** Showcase project with code - code up to 3MB, 1 uploaded file every 7 days
- **Resource:** Useful snippets/resources - code up to 3MB, 1 file every 7 days
- **General Rules:** Description max 500 lines (except articles), 10-min interval, reject duplicates, file upload with language detection from extension, tags like #python, edit after publishing

## Browsing & Interaction

- **Homepage:** Latest posts with filters: Newest, Most Interactive, Articles, Resources, Load more button, collapse/expand long texts
- **Post Interaction:** Like with counter, Comment with counter, Save to Saved page, Share link, Report abusive content, Edit for owner

## Profile & Settings

- **Profile:** Display name, unique @username, short bio, avatar (PNG/JPG/WebP), join date, stats (projects/contributions/articles), tabs: Projects, Posts, Articles, Saved
- **Settings:** Personal info (name/username/bio/avatar), Appearance (light/dark), Email verification, Password reset via secure link, Session logout
- **Legal Pages:** About, Privacy, Contact - Privacy explains processed data (account data, posts/comments/messages, browser preferences) and Firebase from Google usage

## Technical Stack

- SPA with HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- Firebase Authentication, Realtime Database, Cloud Functions
- Firebase App Check with Enterprise reCAPTCHA for anti-abuse
- Hosted on codeex.dev
- Arabic intro content on visitor page for SEO
